name: What should I do immediately if I smell gas in my home?

mainEntity.name: What should I do immediately if I smell gas in my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you smell gas in your home, it's critical to act quickly and safely. Do not turn on or off any lights, use cell phones, or operate any electrical devices, as a spark could ignite the gas. Immediately evacuate everyone from the building and move to a safe distance. Once outside, call your gas utility provider's emergency line and then contact a licensed plumber, such as CG Plumbing Solutions, from a neighbor's phone or a cell phone far away from the suspected leak source. Wait for professionals to arrive and confirm it's safe to re-enter.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you smell gas, evacuate immediately without using any electrical devices. Once safe, call your gas utility and a licensed plumber like CG Plumbing Solutions from an outdoor phone. Do not re-enter until professionals confirm it is safe.
